The photo shows a bowl of porridge, probably a mixed grain or millet congee with some small dark specks. The bowl looks about 15 cm across, and the porridge fills most of it. I estimate roughly 300 g.

Thin grain porridge is about 50 kcal per 100 g, which gives about 150 kcal. The grains look fairly thick, so I'll go slightly higher, to about 60 kcal per 100 g.

300 g × 0.6 = 180 kcal.

{"kcal": 180, "mass_g": 300}
